# Claude (web, desktop & mobile)

**One click:**

[![Add to Claude](https://img.shields.io/badge/Claude-Add_Gupshup-D97757?style=for-the-badge&logo=claude&logoColor=white)](https://claude.ai/customize/connectors?modal=add-custom-connector&connectorName=Gupshup&connectorUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmcp.gupshup.ai%2Fenterprise-auth%2Fmcp)

1. The button opens Claude's **Add custom connector** dialog with the name and URL filled in. Review it and click **Add**.
2. Click **Connect**. When prompted, sign in with your **Gupshup Enterprise account ID and password** for each channel (WhatsApp, SMS, RCS) you want to use, then choose which apps (Analytics, Templates, Campaigns) to allow.
3. In a chat, enable Gupshup from **+ → Connectors**.

The connector syncs to Claude Desktop and mobile, and to Claude Code when you're signed in with the same claude.ai account.

**Team & Enterprise plans:** an Owner adds it once for the organization with the [admin install link](https://claude.ai/admin-settings/connectors?modal=add-custom-connector&connectorName=Gupshup&connectorUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmcp.gupshup.ai%2Fenterprise-auth%2Fmcp). Each member then connects their own Gupshup account.

**Manual setup:** **Customize → Connectors → Add custom connector**, name `Gupshup`, URL:
```
https://mcp.gupshup.ai/enterprise-auth/mcp
```

No Gupshup Enterprise account yet? Email [sales@gupshup.ai](mailto:sales@gupshup.ai).

Something not working? See [Troubleshooting](../troubleshooting.md).
